notes_on_method: Two slip formats present: Bangkok Bank (amount label 'จำนวนเงิน', memo label 'บันทึก') and KBank K+ (amount 'จำนวน:', memo 'บันทึกช่วยจำ:'). A third format, ttb, also appears. Read visually; the legacy process_expenses.js parser only recognises the KBank labels and would silently drop the others.

Buddhist 2-digit year '69' on slip faces = 2569 BE = 2026 CE. This is corroborated by observed evidence, not inferred: Bangkok Bank slips embed the Gregorian date in เลขที่อ้างอิง (e.g. 20260825...), matching the slip face date.

Folder path B1/2_Expenses/Aug26 is a drop box only (owner-confirmed). Branch is taken from memo evidence or left unresolved. Shared-pool fruit purchases legitimately have no branch and are allocated downstream by usage/revenue.

Payer accounts observed so far: Bangkok Bank 098-9-xxx249 (นาย เมธาสิทธิ์), KBank xxx-x-x6560-x (นาย เมธาสิทธิ์ จ), ttb XXX-X-XX674-7 (นาย ฐนกร ไทยขำ). Paying account does not establish benefiting branch.
